def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if not marks:
        return out
    horizontal = len({r for r, c in marks}) == 1
    divider = marks[0][0] if horizontal else marks[0][1]
    other = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2]
    background = max(set(other), key=other.count)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (2, background)]
    if not cells:
        return out
    if horizontal:
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        target = min(rs) - 1 if min(rs) < divider else max(rs) + 1
        if 0 <= target < h:
            out[target] = [8] * w
    else:
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        target = min(cs) - 1 if min(cs) < divider else max(cs) + 1
        if 0 <= target < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8
    return out
PY
